title: Reliability Shipyard: Sprint Playbook for Cross-Functional SLO Activation
summary: Practical 4-week sprint playbook to coordinate product, infra, platform, and SRE teams for a staged SLO activation across core model-serving routes. Uses a shipyard metaphor (prep, launch gates, docking) to keep cross-team responsibilities explicit and reduce last-minute firefighting.
objectives: Establish clear owner/responsibility for each SLO and route
Deliver telemetry and alerting parity for p50/p95/p99 on target routes
Stitch runbooks and rollbacks so canary -> full rollout is scriptable
Validate fallback behaviors (thin model, read-only caches, regional failover)
Ensure incident/playbook rehearsals for at least 2 common failure modes
scope: Targeting three production routes (text-generate, chat-stream, embeddings-batch). Not covering Dedicated capacity contractual changes or billing. This sprint focuses on instrumentation, runbooks, small-capacity fallback tests, and a staged canary plan.
success_metrics: Telemetry: 95% of p99 latency datapoints show tags by model+hw+route
Alerting: Mean Time To Detect (MTTD) < 2 min for high-severity SLO breaches
Runbooks: 3 runbooks validated and executed in tabletop with < 20 min time to resolution in simulation
Rollout: Canary to 10% then 50% with zero customer-facing errors > 1 minute
Error budget: No >50% burn in any route during rollout week
timeline: Week 0 (prep): preflight checks, instrumentation audit. Week 1: telemetry & alerts shipping, basic runbook drafts. Week 2: canary wiring + small-scale fallback tests. Week 3: tabletop rehearsals + canary to 10%. Week 4: ramp plan to 50% and retrospective. Detailed dates: May 11 - Jun 7, 2026.

risks: Incomplete telemetry tagging causes misattribution and false alerts
Capacity regressions when enabling canary on noisy routes
Runbooks not updated -> oncall confusion during incidents
Cross-team calendar mismatches delay gating decisions
Undocumented fallback behaviors cause data divergence
mitigations: Telemetry: preflight tag coverage report with mapping to routes and models
Capacity: synthetic load test on a shadowed canary path before live ramp
Runbooks: tabletop exercises with scripted steps and single-point-of-contact
Calendars: publish daily 15-min shipyard standups; hard gating deadlines
Fallback: automated verification job to assert cache/read-only modes reproduce expected outputs
